strings.name: Alexander Stubb
strings.summary: Stubb began in EU research and policy, then served as MEP, foreign minister, prime minister and finance minister before joining the European Investment Bank and European University Institute. President since 2024, he addresses Nordic security, Ukraine and European cooperation in a Finland already within NATO, while discussing international order and multilateralism through diplomacy and writing.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His premiership and presidency build on long involvement in EU affairs, Nordic security and international relations.

strings.highlights.h1.title: European policy experience
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combines research, European parliamentary, ministerial and financial-institution work.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Presidential diplomacy and security
strings.highlights.h2.text: Promotes European and transatlantic cooperation in a Finland already within NATO.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Climate summit statement
strings.timeline.t1.text: Published COP31 text emphasized multilateralism, science, innovation and the clean transition.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Becomes Finnish president
strings.timeline.t2.text: Inaugurated as the republic’s thirteenth president.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Joins European University Institute
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became professor and director of its School of Transnational Governance, later taking election leave.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joins European Investment Bank
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes prime minister
strings.timeline.t5.text: Led a coalition government until May 2015.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becomes foreign minister
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from the European Parliament into Finland’s government.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Enters European Parliament
strings.timeline.t7.text: Elected as a National Coalition Party candidate.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns international-relations doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Studied flexible EU integration at the London School of Economics.
